titleStmt.title: Bhavnagar plates of Śīlāditya III, [Valabhī] year 348, Pauṣa śuddha 2

msContents.summary: Grant of land (100 pādāvarta of land and a cistern surrounded by 25 pādāvarta) in favour of one Sāmavedin and two Yajurvedins (father and son)

div.p:
* svasti vijayaskandhāvārāT meghavanavāsakaāT prasabhapraṇatāmitrāṇāṁ maitrakaāṇām atulabalasaṁpannamaṇḍalābhogasaṁsaktaprahāraśatalabdhapratāpāt pratāpātpratāpopana
tadānamānārjavopārjjitānurāgād anurāgād anuraktamaulabhṛtaḥśreṇībalāvāptarājyaśriyaḥ paramamāheśvaraśrībhaṭakkād avyavacchinnarājavaṅśān maātāpitṛcaraṇāravindapra
ṇatipravidhautāśeṣakalmaṣaḥ śaiśavāt prabhṛti khaḍgadvitīyabāhur eva samadaparagajaghaṭāsphoṭanaprakāśitasatvanikaṣaḥ tatprabhāvapraṇatārāticūḍārakttnaprabhaāsaṁ
saktapādanakharaśmisaṁhatiḥ sakalasmṛtipraṇītamārggasamyakparipālanaprajāhṛdayarañjanānvarttharājaśabdo ruūpakaāntisthairyyyagāmbhīryyabuddhisaṁpadbhiḥ smaraśaśāṅkādrirājodadhitridaśagurudhaneśaān ati
śayānaḥ śaraṇātgatābhayāapradānaparatayā tṛṇavadapāstāśesṣasvakāryyaphalaḥ prārtthanādhikārtthapradānānanditavidvatsuhṛtpraṇayihṛdayaḥ pādacārīva sakalabhuvanamaṇḍalābhogapra
modaḥ paramamāheśvaraḥ śrīguhasenas tasya sutas tatpādanakhamayūkhasantaānavisṛtajāhnavījalaughaprakṣālitāśeṣakalmaṣaḥ praṇayiśatasahasropajīvyamānasaṁpad rūpalobhād ivāśritaḥ
sarabhasam ābhigāmikair gguṇais vsahajaśaktiśikṣāviśeṣavismaāpitākhiladhanurddharaḥ prathamanarapatisamatisṛṣṭānām anupālayitā dharmmadāyānām apānkarttā prajopaghaātakaāriṇām upapla
vānāṁ darśayitā śrīsarasvatyeor ekādhivaāsasya saṁhatārātipakṣalakṣmīparibhogadakṣavikramo vikramopasaṁprāptavimalapārtthivaśrīḥ paramamāheśvaraḥ śrīdharasenas tasya sutas tatpādā
nuddhyātaḥ sakalajagadānandanaātyadbhutaguṇasamudayasthagitasamagradiṅmaṇḍalaḥ samaraśatavijayaśobhāsanaāthamaṇḍalāgradyautibhoāsuratarānsaspīṭhodūḍhagu

Aparasīmny eva dvitīyakhaṁḍaṁ viṅśatibhūpādāvarttaparimāṇaṁ yasya pūrvvataḥ nadī dakṣiṇataḥ saiva nadī Aparataḥ bhaṭikāgrāmasīmā Uttarataḥ nadī tathā triṛtīyakhaṁḍaṁ Uttarasīmni
daśabhūpādāvarttaparimāṇaṁ yasya pūrvvataḥ Ādityadattaprakṛṣṭakṣetraṁ . dakṣiṇataḥ saggamadinnaprakṛṣṭakṣetraṁ Aparataḥ dāsakaprakṛṣṭakṣetraṁ . Uttarataḥ dāsaka
prakṛṣṭakṣetraṁ . tathā Aparasīmni kuṭumbiguggakamaheśvararogghasīhaiḥ prāakṛṣṭasirīṣavāpīti saṁjñitā pañcāviṅśatibhūpādāvarttaparisarā vāpī yasyāḥ pūrvvattaḥ
samudraprakṛṣṭakṣetraṁ . dakṣiṇataḥ guggakaprakṛṣṭakṣetraṁ . Aparataḥ maheśvaraprakṛṣṭakṣetraṁ . Uttarataḥ saggamadinnaprakṛṣṭakṣetraṁ tathā makadvaukevātandhamakagrāme
Aparasīmni kuṭumbimātṛdāsaprakṛṣṭavaḍasaṃjñitaṁ paṁcāśadbhūpādāvarttaparimāṇaṁ kṣetrakhaṁḍaṁ yasya pūrvvataḥ brāhmaṇadattullakasatkakṣetraṁ . dakṣiṇataḥ
taṭākaṁ Aparataḥ dattullakasatkabrahmadeyakṣetraṁ . Uttarataḥ rājavaṭṭaṁ . Evam idam āghāṭanaviśuddhaṁ vāpīsamanvitakṣetrakhaṇḍadvayaṁ sodraṅgaṁ soparikaraṁ sabhūta
